about: Nightforge's own per-game profiles, tested on Macs. They take precedence over umu-protonfixes. Fields: graphics (dxmt|dxvk|wined3d|d3dmetal), arguments, dllOverrides, registry, windowsVersion, winetricks, metalFX (false = keep MetalFX off), frameLimit (automatic FPS limit), vulkanSamplers (samplers per shader stage reported to Vulkan games), preferWindows (true = Automatic keeps the Windows version although Steam has a 64-bit Mac one), saves (save folders for games without Steam Cloud rules, carried over when the game changes between its Windows and Mac version), antiCheat / antiCheatOnline ([] = runs on a Mac despite what AreWeAntiCheatYet says), avx (false = start without Rosetta's AVX hint, for games that crash on it), fileEdits ([{path, find, replace, root, once}] in the game's own settings files before each start; path relative to its folder, or to root – a Windows root as in saves; once = a starting value, applied a single time), iniSettings ([{root, path, section, values}] set in the game's own .ini files before each start), retina (true = the game sees the full Retina resolution; Steam restarts when it changes), gog (the same game's GOG product IDs, which get this profile too), ignoreUpstream, note.

550.name: Left 4 Dead 2
550.note: Tested 2026-10-26 on M5: DXVK fails (MoltenVK rejects its buffers, 'Failed to create D3D device'), Nightforge switches to WineD3D by itself. Menu and play work, but it crashed after about a minute twice; -vulkan (Valve's DXVK) and WineD3D's Vulkan renderer don't start.

50130.name: Mafia II (Classic)
50130.note: Tested 2026-10-31 on M5 with the GOG version (1816059595) on winecx 4.7.3. DXVK's Direct3D 9 gets no device on MoltenVK: it needs geometryShader and shaderCullDistance, which MoltenVK lacks (KosmicKrisp advertises both since Mesa 14f59d06). WineD3D plays, but stutters at ~360 % CPU, and FMOD's sound came doubled, like reverb. APEX PhysX runs on the CPU on a Mac (no CUDA under Wine); Proton players turn it off for the same stutter. Above ~100 FPS the game sticks in slow motion during police chases, so VSync stays on.

251570.name: 7 Days to Die
251570.note: Tested 2026-10-24 on M5: ~63 FPS with DXMT; with DXVK the game sees only 128 MB VRAM and drops to low textures and ~30 FPS. Steam's no-EAC launch option is picked automatically.

275850.name: No Man's Sky
275850.note: Tested 2026-10-25 on M5: the Windows version (Vulkan) starts on MoltenVK only with Nightforge's Vulkan layer, which drops wide lines and reports 32 samplers per stage (24 is still too few). Steam also sells a native Mac version.

1422450.name: Deadlock
1422450.note: Tested 2026-10-26 on M5: plays with DXVK at 60-120 FPS (the Vulkan layer's count). Steam may first ask about controller firmware; Nightforge shows that window.

1623730.name: Palworld
1623730.note: Tested 2026-10-26 on M5: steady 60 FPS (frame limit) with DXMT and -dx11. With DXVK only the HUD showed over a black world. Steam asks for the EULA once.

3132990.name: Black Myth: Wukong Benchmark Tool
3132990.note: Tested 2026-10-26 on M5 with D3DMetal 4.0b3 on winecx 4.7.3. DirectX 12 through D3DMetal: 70 FPS average, 56 in the slowest fifth (Niedrig, 1512x982, FSR), clean picture. DirectX 11 (-dx11) through DXMT: ~45 FPS with heavy texture noise. Crashes on an illegal instruction ~30 s in with ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1, and at start with frame generation (InsertFrame), which it switches on by itself at its first start.

3907790.name: OxyRail
3907790.note: Tested 2026-10-24 on M5: ~75 FPS with DXMT vs 45-50 with DXVK on Extreme.

3916150.name: The Last Caretaker Demo
3916150.note: Tested 2026-10-28 on M5 (Unreal 5.7.4). DirectX 11 fails on every layer: DXMT stays black while its graphics memory grows by ~400 MB/s, DXVK 3 on KosmicKrisp and D3DMetal crash. DirectX 12 through D3DMetal plays; with Rosetta's AVX hint it crashes after ~2 min (illegal instruction while precompiling shaders). Nanite and virtual shadow maps cost D3DMetal half the frame rate (30 -> 64 FPS without them, Engine.ini). With full Retina output (3024x1964), Low, FSR Performance and FSR frame generation: 50-55 FPS, sharp. Ray tracing and MegaLights stay off. The menu's background video stays black.
